title: 'What would Coleen think?' - Man Utd legend Wayne Rooney spotted out drinking with two women until 3:25am on eve of Brit Awards
desc: Former England captain Wayne Rooney was spotted drinking until the early hours of the morning with two mystery women at a pre-Brit Awards party in Manchester. The legendary ex-United striker enjoyed an allegedly alcohol-fuelled evening at a fancy hotel that housed a number of celebrities ahead of a glitzy ceremony taking place at Co-op Live. Rooney’s wife, Coleen, was nowhere to be seen.
